Hoist and winch operators (O*NET/SOC 53-7041.00 "Hoist and Winch Operators") are personnel who operate or tend hoists or winches to lift and pull loads using power-operated cable equipment. Official scope text: Operate or tend hoists or winches to lift and pull loads using power-operated cable equipment. Their core tasks are to operate the drum to wind and unwind cable per signals and load specifications, control load position and speed, and complete equipment inspections, rigging connections, and maintenance records at the same time; common job titles include Hoist Operator, Hoisting Operator, Hoistman, Service Operator, Winch Derrick Operator, and Winchman. The U.S. data on this page correspond to the precise occupation 53-7041.00; mainland China's position entry and safety requirements are labeled separately under their own jurisdictional sources, and the two must not be applied to one another.
